title: 第3548章 前辈不要看第3547章 神农百草经
slug: 多子多福这个世界美女太多
content_zh:
“前辈......”
柳青瑶看向李长生，脸上的震惊之色越发浓郁：
“您......”
她此刻迫不及待的想要询问李长生操作方法。
但是看着他那忙碌的背影，硬生生忍住了。
只是心中却掀起了惊涛骇浪：
“丹药二次炼制，这是每一个炼药师都梦寐以求的手段。”
“炼药界研究了几万年，但是到现在都没有任何一个人能够研究出头绪。”
“多少惊才绝艳的炼药天才被寄予厚望，但最后都断言，丹药二次炼制无法实现......”
“若是前辈真的能够进行丹药的二次炼制，那多少炼制失败的丹药可以获得拯救？”
“对于我柳家来说，丹药炼制的成本至少能够节省五成......”
“五成......”
柳青瑶越想越是心惊：
“那可是半个柳家的财富啊。”
这一刻，李长生在柳青瑶心中的地位直线提升。
她不再把李长生当成一位前辈，不再把他当成一个神农传人。
而是把他当成了能够和柳家平起平坐的高人。
可李长生带给柳青瑶的震惊还不止这些。
只见李长生拿出了一株株药草，每拿出一株，柳青瑶的嘴巴便张大一分：
“一千万年年份......”

“三千万年年份......”
“五千......五千万年年份？”
“这......这怎么可能？”
“这些药草，随便拿出一株，都能够震惊整个修仙界，都能够让无数炼药师抢破头皮.......”
“现在前辈竟然为了帮我炼制丹药，竟然拿出了这么多顶级药草......”
一时间，柳青瑶心中一阵温暖，就连李长生在她眼中都开始发起光来了。
李长生没有处理药草，而是直接将药草一股脑的全都扔进了炼丹炉。
柳青瑶捂住了嘴巴，差点叫出声来：
“不处理药草，直接扔进炼丹炉？”
“这是新的炼制手法，还是说，这是神农鼎特有的能力？”
微微沉吟，柳青瑶也拿出了炼丹炉，学着李长生的手法，开始炼制丹药。
一刻钟之后，噗的一声响起，柳青瑶的炼丹炉出现了一道细微的裂缝。
一缕缕黑色烟气从裂缝之中泄露而出，直接喷了柳青瑶一脸。
黑色烟气散开之后，柳青瑶一脸茫然，双眼空洞，脸上身上全都覆盖了一层黑色......
李长生瞥了她一眼，嘴角勾了勾：
“柳姑娘，你这是干什么？”
content_en:
"Senior..."
Liu Qingyao looked at Li Changsheng, the look of shock on her face became more intense:
"You..."
She couldn't wait to ask Li Changsheng how to operate it.
But looking at his busy back, I resisted.
But there was a storm in my heart:
"Second refining of elixirs is a method that every alchemist dreams of."
"The medicine refining industry has been researching for tens of thousands of years, but no one has been able to figure it out until now."
"How many amazing and brilliant alchemy geniuses have high hopes, but in the end they all concluded that the secondary refining of the elixir cannot be realized..."
"If seniors are really able to refining elixirs for the second time, how many elixirs that failed to be refined can be saved?"
"For our Liu family, the cost of elixir refining can be saved by at least 50%..."
"Fifty percent..."
The more Liu Qingyao thought about it, the more frightened she became:
"That's half the Liu family's wealth."
At this moment, Li Changsheng's status in Liu Qingyao's heart skyrocketed.
She no longer regards Li Changsheng as a senior, nor as a descendant of Shennong.
Instead, he was regarded as an expert who could be on equal footing with the Liu family.
But the shock that Li Changsheng brought to Liu Qingyao didn't stop there.
Li Changsheng took out a bunch of herbs, and Liu Qingyao's mouth opened wider every time he took out one:
"Ten million years..."
"Thirty million years..."
"Five thousand...fifty million years?"
"This...how is this possible?"
"Any one of these medicinal herbs can shock the entire world of immortal cultivation, and can make countless alchemists steal their scalps..."
"Now, in order to help me refine the elixir, senior actually took out so many top-notch medicinal herbs..."
For a moment, Liu Qingyao felt warm in her heart, and even Li Changsheng began to shine in her eyes.
Li Changsheng did not deal with the herbs, but directly threw them all into the alchemy furnace.
Liu Qingyao covered her mouth and almost shouted:
"You don't process the herbs and just throw them into the alchemy furnace?"
"Is this a new refining technique, or is this the unique ability of the Shennong Cauldron?"
After pondering slightly, Liu Qingyao also took out the alchemy furnace, imitated Li Changsheng's method, and began to refine the elixir.
A quarter of an hour later, there was a popping sound, and a slight crack appeared in Liu Qingyao's alchemy furnace.
Wisps of black smoke leaked out from the cracks and sprayed directly into Liu Qingyao's face.
After the black smoke dispersed, Liu Qingyao looked blank, her eyes were empty, and her face and body were covered with a layer of black...
Li Changsheng glanced at her and curled his lips:
"Miss Liu, what are you doing?"
